December 16, 2024

# New revocation reasons for payment methods for 2025-01

DateDecember 16, 2024

Version[2025-01](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-01)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

As of GraphQL Admin API version 2025-01, we've added new values to the `CustomerPaymentMethodRevocationReason` enum to provide more granular information about payment method revocations. This enhancement helps apps better understand and handle scenarios where a customer's payment method needs to be revoked.

No action is required for existing implementations, as this is a non-breaking change that adds new enum values.

Learn more about payment method revocation on [Shopify.dev](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/current/enums/CustomerPaymentMethodRevocationReason).
